sections.title: What's New
items: Daylight Mirror is built in, so you can show your Mac or PC screen on your DC-1 over USB-C or Wi-Fi with the latest Daylight app for your computer from the Daylight Support page.
The Software Updates app is new: it tells you when an update is ready, shows your version and serial number, and installs the update when you are ready.
Tap Release Notes in Software Updates to see what's new in each update.
A Store app is now on your tablet, where you can get the latest Daylight Mirror.
Use a USB webcam for video calls in apps such as Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams, with the tablet's own microphone.
See the battery level of a Bluetooth keyboard or mouse in Settings, if the device reports it.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Kindle is updated to version 8.157 the first time your tablet starts after the update, and your books and sign-in carry over.
Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams from the Play Store can use your camera and microphone on your first call without asking, and you can turn this off in Settings.
The screen now refreshes between 45 and 90 Hz, which replaces any refresh rate you set before.
